turns.question: How far through September 2026's ad budget did we get by the end of the month, as a share of the budget?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no metric for the total ad budget or the share of budget used, so I cannot give that percentage; the closest metrics are remaining budget (EUR), which was 4,130 EUR left at the end of September 2026 (1-30 September), and ad spend (EUR), which was 6,270 EUR over the same days. Late: marketing.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
